explanation: Read in this direction the edge says the intervention was the answer to the war. The article's first sentence: "On 19 March 2011, a NATO-led coalition began a military intervention into the ongoing Libyan Civil War to implement United Nations Security Council Resolution 1973", a resolution passed "with the stated intent to have 'an immediate ceasefire in Libya, including an end to the current attacks against civilians, which it said might constitute crimes against humanity'". The war is what was reacted to and the resolution is the form the reaction took; the coalition had no quarrel with Libya before the attacks on civilians the resolution names.
